about: Thule Group AB (publ) operates as a sports and outdoor company in Europe, North America, and internationally. It offers roof boxes, roof racks, bike carriers, rooftop tents, and windbreakers, as well as solutions for water and winter sports. The company also provides bike trailers, jogging and all-terrain strollers, child bikes, car seats, and carriers and harnesses for dog transportation; and duffel bags, backpacks, luggage, laptop bags, hiking backpacks, camera bags, and cases for consumer electronics. It sells its products under the Case Logic, Thule, and Quad Lock brands. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
